name: MisterTranslate
author: mistertranslate

sections.description:
MisterTranslate helps you launch multilingual WordPress content faster without rebuilding pages by hand.

It is designed for websites that care about layout, structure and conversion. Instead of translating plain text only, MisterTranslate detects how content is stored and translates it in a way that keeps page builders, WooCommerce fields and visual structure intact.

Whether you manage landing pages, a WooCommerce catalog or a multilingual client site, MisterTranslate helps you translate content faster while keeping control over terminology and workflow.

Why site owners use MisterTranslate

  • Translate pages, posts and custom post types from one panel
  • Preserve Elementor layouts with segment-based translation
  • Translate WooCommerce products, categories and attributes
  • Keep terminology consistent with glossary rules
  • Estimate translation cost before launching
  • Process content in batches to save time
  • Connect translated content with Polylang and WPML
  • Purge WP Rocket cache after translation

Supported builders and editors

  • Elementor
  • Avia / Enfold
  • WordPress Block Editor
  • Classic Editor

Built for multilingual growth

MisterTranslate supports 80+ languages, including Spanish, English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian and Hindi.

Use it to:

  • launch product pages in new markets
  • translate landing pages without breaking design
  • localize WooCommerce catalogs faster
  • keep brand names and key terms consistent
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mistertranslate folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress
  3. Go to MisterTranslate > Settings
  4. Enter your Client ID and Secret Key
  5. Open the MisterTranslate panel and start translating

To get API credentials, visit mistertranslate.com.
sections.faq:
What does MisterTranslate translate?

Pages, posts, custom post types, WooCommerce products, categories and attributes.

Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. MisterTranslate detects Elementor content and translates it with a segment-based approach to preserve layout and widget structure.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes. It can translate product titles, descriptions, short descriptions, categories and attributes.

Can I control brand names or fixed terminology?

Yes. The glossary lets you keep terms unchanged or define specific translations.

Does it work with multilingual plugins?

Yes. MisterTranslate integrates with Polylang and WPML for multilingual linking workflows.

Can I estimate translation cost before starting?

Yes. The plugin includes a cost estimator and shows available balance inside the admin panel.

Is it useful for agencies?

Yes. It is especially useful for agencies and site managers who need to localize multiple pages or products faster.
sections.changelog:
4.2.4

  • Fixed Avia/Enfold retranslation not updating post content correctly
  • Added error logging for Elementor path resolution to improve debugging
  • Improved reliability of Elementor segment-based translation

4.2.3

  • Fixed Spectra/UAGB CSS compatibility for translated pages
  • Plugin now automatically ensures Spectra uses inline CSS to prevent styling issues on duplicated pages
  • Improved stability for sites using Spectra page builder blocks

4.2.1

  • Improved Elementor translation with segment-based approach
  • Added smart detection for third-party Elementor addon fields
  • Added FontAwesome icon filtering to reduce unnecessary token usage
  • Added CSS value protection for gradients, transforms and other visual values
  • Added Elementor meta safety checks for edit mode, template type and version
  • Added WP Rocket cache purge integration
  • Improved WordPress coding standards compliance

4.2.0

  • Added batch translation support
  • Added translation cost estimator
  • Added glossary management
  • Added Polylang and WPML integration
  • Added low balance notifications
